For each table in `create` and `alter`, the statements
database_node_create_tables would run with the same request, for the user
to read before it does. Nothing is changed: a table to alter is read
(its columns and how many rows it has) to write its SQL, and the others
don't connect at all. confirm_replace and expected are ignored.
